lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Gertrude Nelson is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Gertrude Nelson is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Gertrude kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Gertrude's gone." Jose looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Gertrude." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Darius blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Gertrude Nelson, 41 days. The mantle passes to Darius Bautista.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Darius Bautista, 51 — a Dentist. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Beard Moss, Echo Location.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Gertrude — and Gertrude is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Jose, Benjamin, Olivia and 7 more speak for Darius — "Gertrude trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Darius before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
